description: Targeted ScanTailor refinement space derived from the 2,304-set exhaustive characterization. That run classified boundary search margin and projection smoothing as the dominant controls, with projection smoothing winning at the 0.004 lower grid edge. This compact 480-member Cartesian grid extends smoothing down to 0.001, increases resolution around the useful boundary-margin basin, and retains both the detector baseline and the 0.9312 exhaustive winner. Secondary dimensions are intentionally reduced to baseline/winner-relevant values so refinement effort is spent on the characterized dominant interaction rather than re-expanding dormant or zombie axes.
